scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Brasilis^000000, a country as passionate as the sun.
If you have any questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513巴西^000000，这个如太阳般热情的国度。
有什么问题，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Where can I guide you?

[Brasilis Guide]
The Brasilis Hotel is located just above, ^FF3355+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西酒店就在上方，小地图上的^FF3355+^000000标记处。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Do you want to go through the rough jungle? You can take a 
Jungle Cable here ^CE6300+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
想穿过崎岖的丛林吗？
您可以在小地图上的^CE6300+^000000标记处乘坐丛林缆车。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The pride of Brasilis, the world scale Art Museum is at ^A5BAAD+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西引以为傲的世界级艺术博物馆，位于小地图上的^A5BAAD+^000000标记处。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
You can buy items for hunting at the Market here ^55FF33+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
在小地图上的^55FF33+^000000标记处有个市场，能买到狩猎所需的物品。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The iconic monument of Brasilis, the Verass Monument stands at ^3355FF+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西的地标——维拉斯纪念碑，位于小地图上的^3355FF+^000000标记处。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
我会清除您小地图上的所有标记。
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Wandering on your own is always the best way to explore. Anyway, take care.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
想探索一座城，自己四处走走总是最好的办法。
总之，请多保重。
